name: Akabane Kisaki
source:
Likes: Fine food, being pampered
Dislikes: Boring men

The wife of a famous actor. Kisaki herself used to be a model in the past and still has a strong fanbase. She is spoiled and loves being pampered with attention due to her surroundings, and is also a bit of a gold digger.
